proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal – Report on EEO Policy Risk
proposals.proponent: The National Center for Public Policy Research
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a public report on potential risks of omitting "viewpoint" and "ideology" from BlackRock's written EEO policy.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends that our shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal – Amend Bylaws to Require Independent Board Chair
proposals.topic_summary: Requests amending bylaws so the Board must elect an independent director as Chairman, phased in by the 2025 AGM.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends that our shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal – Report on Proxy Voting Record and Policies for Climate Change-Related Proposals
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a board review of BlackRock's 2023 proxy voting record and climate-related proxy voting policies.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends that our shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal.
